🎥🎬: Gears of War: E-Day 

Fourteen years before the events of the original Gears of War, Marcus Fenix returns home to Sera as humanity faces its darkest nightmare yet. On Emergence Day, the Locust Horde suddenly erupts from underground, launching a devastating invasion that throws the planet into chaos.

Marcus and his best friend Dom Santiago are thrust into the fight as soldiers trying to survive the first hours of the Locust invasion. With cities falling and humanity caught completely off guard, the two must fight their way through overwhelming enemy forces while witnessing the beginning of the war that will define their lives.
